model.kind: independent one-vs-rest probit GPs with normalized marginal probabilities
model.joint_label_draw: argmax of one joint latent draw from each independent one-vs-rest GP

acquisition.score: joint multiclass disagreement probability times distance penalty times midpoint novelty factor
acquisition.round_rule: select one unlabeled two-endpoint pair, label both with the frozen PDE, refit, and repeat

novelty_handling.other_or_U_policy: exclude from one-vs-rest fitting, retain as labeled novelty anchor, continue within the fixed budget

success_criteria.primary: at least one newly queried state has outcome B
success_criteria.stronger: the ordered union of allowed coarse labels and new labels contains adjacent C-B and B-A brackets
success_criteria.dynamical_followup: multiclass-guarded edge tracking is attempted separately on each discovered adjacent bracket

experimental_separation.historical_knowledge: a three-point pilot already indicated C-B-A; the confirmatory target is adaptive recovery of the unmapped fine structure
